description: Periodic fund documents (monthly reports, factsheets, product sheets): relevance names the sibling fund documents to reject (KID, prospectus, scenarios, annual reports).

relevance.true: The linked document is a monthly report, factsheet or product sheet about one fund, of the kind the goal asks for, whatever period it covers.
relevance.false: The linked document is a different kind of document than the goal asks for, even when it is for the same fund and the same month (for example a performance scenario, a key information document (KID, KIID or KBI), an announcement or notice, a prospectus or fund rules, an annual or semi-annual report, or a policy disclosure), or it is the same document translated into a language other than the language the goal is written in.

page_kinds.subject_page: A page about one fund, product or portfolio, which usually lists that fund's own documents.
page_kinds.document_listing: A page that lists many documents (reports, announcements, disclosures, downloads).
page_kinds.category_or_overview: A page that groups or lists funds or products, without their documents.
page_kinds.news_or_article: A news item, blog post, press release or article.
page_kinds.company_or_legal: About us, contact, careers, legal notices, privacy, cookie policy, login, or similar.
